api.update: echarts.init(null, null, {renderer: 'svg', ssr: true, width: 800, height: 600}); setOption (animation false); zr.storage.getDisplayList(true); no animation frame is ever stepped
api.model: sm.getData(): data.tree.getNodeByDataIndex(i) {name, depth, height, parentNode, children, viewChildren, getValue(), getLayout()}, getRawDataItem(i) (after completeTreeValue), getItemVisual(i, 'style') {fill, stroke}; sm.layoutInfo; sm.option.levels (after setDefault)
api.view: chart.getViewOfSeriesModel(sm)._storage {nodeGroup, background, content}[rawIndex]; content.getTextContent() (the label Text: style.text / width / height / padding, isTruncated, transform, z2, childrenRef() TSpans); view._breadcrumb.group (x, y, the Polygon children with their eventData.nodeData and their Text)
api.paint: zr.storage.getDisplayList(true), restricted to the elements under the series view's group (a gallery title is another component): every one must be a background, content, label TSpan, header ('upper') TSpan, crumb polygon or crumb TSpan of the one series
api.header: background.getTextContent() (the upper label Text: style.text / width / height / padding, isTruncated, transform, z2, childrenRef() TSpans) and background.textConfig.layoutRect
api.production: every hand-written and gallery case records identically through dist/echarts.min.js

notes: Rows: row i = the i-th node of a PRE-ORDER walk of {name: series.name, children: data} in the WRITTEN order; row 0 is the virtual root. completeTreeValue (post-order, a missing / null / NaN parent value takes the children sum, an explicit parent value is kept, v < 0 -> 0, an array value uses and writes back [0]). Sorting never reorders rows: viewChildren is a sorted, filtered copy.

Option chain: item -> levels[depth] -> designated (the parent's colour, during the visual only) -> series merged over defaultOption. It includes name: chainName is what the label (without formatter) and the crumb show. levels[0] belongs to the virtual root. setDefault puts a COPY of the global palette on levels[0].color unless any level has a truthy itemStyle.color or a truthy color other than 'none' (an empty list counts).
Sort: absent -> true -> desc; a truthy non-'asc' value -> desc; falsy (false, null, 0, '') -> no sort AND no visibleMin. Desc ties: higher dataIndex first; asc ties: lower first.

Layout (all LOCAL to the parent origin, no rounding): see upstream.md 2.2-2.3. visibleMin (parent chain, default 10) cuts from the smallest with a running, reduced sum; kept children share the reduced sum. childrenVisibleMin hides grandchildren. Invisible (outside the canvas clip) nodes get no group, no element, no colour.

Transforms: T(root group) = (layoutInfo.x, layoutInfo.y); T(child) = (x + T.x, y + T.y); a group whose local |x| and |y| are both <= 5e-5 copies its parent's transform (groupLocalDropped). A label Text's transform is [1, 0, 0, 1, (bw + T.x) + cw / 2, (bw + T.y) + ch / 2] (same 5e-5 rule, no parent); its TSpans copy it.

Colour: travelTree over viewChildren in sorted order; a node's colour = item itemStyle.color > levels[depth].itemStyle.color > the designated (parent-mapped or inherited) colour > series itemStyle.color. The parent's chain `color` list (non-empty array) maps child k to list[k % n]. stroke = the chain borderColor ('#fff' default) and becomes the BACKGROUND rect fill; only nodes without viewChildren get a fill (undefined = no fill: the content rect has fill null).

Elements: per visible node a background rect (z2 depth*100+20, shape (0, 0, w, h, r)) and, without viewChildren, a content rect (z2 depth*100+30, shape (bw, bw, max(w-2bw,0), max(h-2bw,0), r)); r = itemStyle.borderRadius || 0. The label Text z2 = the running maximum z2 over the pre-order walk + 2. Paint order = a stable sort by (zlevel, z, z2) over creation order: backgrounds and contents by depth band, labels, crumbs (100000), crumb texts (100002).

Label text: the chain formatter (formatTpl {a} series name, {b} store name, {c} the completed raw value) else the chain name; null or '' -> a Text with no TSpan. Box: width = max(cw - pad[1] - pad[3], 0), height likewise; lines beyond floor(height / lineHeight) dropped (lineHeight = measure('国')); each line through zrender truncateSingleLine with minChar 2 and '...' (dropped when it does not fit), containerWidth = max(0, width - 1), '' for containerWidth 0. isTruncated: lines dropped or any line cut. The TSpan x = pad[3]/2 - pad[1]/2 (0), y from (0 - n*lh/2) + lh/2 accumulated.

Breadcrumb (frame 1): target = the last node in pre-order (descending only into hits) whose UNTRANSFORMED background (0, 0, w, h) contains (W/2, H/2), else the root (fallbackRoot). Items root first: width max(measure(text, '12px sans-serif') + 16, emptyItemWidth), gap 8, arrow 5; collapse to emptyItemWidth without text from the root side while the total exceeds getLayoutRect({left, right, top, bottom}).width. The group is placed by positionElement on the zrender union of the polygon bboxes; crumb texts at (bbox.x + gx) + bbox.width / 2, (bbox.y + gy) + bbox.height / 2.

Colours are upstream's literals: palette (ecModel.option.color) '#5070dd' .. '#3fbe95', border / label '#fff', crumb '#e8ebf0', crumb ink '#54555a'. A theme-driven port must inject these, never compare theme colours against them.

M1 cases (no batch field): none sets colorSaturation, borderColorSaturation, colorAlpha, upperLabel, leafDepth, colorMappingBy, visualDimension / visualMin / visualMax, decal or a series-level color list (checked; a case that did would stop the run). ref.js variants 6 (leafDepth) and 9 (upperLabel) are skipped there. M2 / M3 cases (batch field) may set colorSaturation, borderColorSaturation and upperLabel, and still refuse colorAlpha, leafDepth, colorMappingBy, visualDimension / visualMin / visualMax, decal and a series-level color list.

M2 saturation: a parent maps its children when its chain `color` is not a non-empty list, it has a colour (visuals.color not null / 'none'), and its chain colorSaturation (item colorSaturation > levels[depth].colorSaturation > series colorSaturation) is a non-empty array: child visual = linearMap(linearMap(child.getValue(), dataExtent, [0, 1], clamp), [0, 1], [range[0], range[1] (= range[0] for a one-entry range)], clamp); dataExtent = [min, max] over the sorted children BEFORE the visibleMin cut; min == max gives 0.5, the middle of the range. The child's itemStyle.colorSaturation chain (item > level) wins over the mapped value, which wins over the series itemStyle.colorSaturation; the value is inherited by descendants that are not remapped.

M2 colours: calculateColor = the colour, then (if colorSaturation is TRUTHY: 0 changes nothing) zrender modifyHSL(colour, null, null, s), which sets HSL LIGHTNESS: parse -> rgba2hsla -> l = clamp(s, 0, 1) -> hsla2rgba (h = ((H % 360) + 360) % 360 / 360; channels Math.round(x * 255) clamped to 0..255; alpha kept) -> 'rgba(r,g,b,a)'. borderColorSaturation (chain, != null) makes the stroke modifyHSL(calculateColor(visuals), null, null, bcs) (0 is black), or null without a colour. Then dataStyleTask: a raw item itemStyle color / borderColor / opacity replace fill / stroke / opacity.

M3 headers: only a PARENT (viewChildren) whose upperLabelHeight (show ? height : 0 on its chain) is non-zero gets a header Text on its BACKGROUND; a leaf keeps its content label (its content rect is inset by bw only, the reserved strip is ignored). Text: upperLabel.formatter, else label.formatter, else the chain name. Rect {bw, 0, w - 2bw, upperHeight} through the background transform (a negative width flips); position [x, y] (default [0, '50%']): left / middle at (rect.x + x, rect.y + y%); 'inside': centre / middle. Width max(rect.width - pad, 0), height max(upperHeight - pad, 0), the label truncation / line drop. z2 = running max + 2. Colour: an option colour ('inherit' = the border colour) as is, no stroke; otherwise 'inside' over a filled background: #333 (lum > 0.5) / #eee (> 0.2) / #ccc, stroke = the background colour when (lum(fill) < 0.4) == dark mode; anything else (the default array position, or an unfilled background): #333 (#ccc in dark mode) with a 2px stroke = the canvas background blended over white (black in dark mode). Opacity: upperLabel.opacity, else the node style opacity.
Not recorded: hover / emphasis, drill-down, zoom / roam, animations, the second-frame breadcrumb (which would use the previous frame's transforms).

measure.rule: px = the number before 'px' in the font (else 12); a font containing 'mono' measures px * length; otherwise the sum, over UTF-16 units left to right, of ratio[code - 32] * px for codes 32..126 and px for any other unit. A label's line height is measure('国') = px. Upstream measures the breadcrumb text in '12px sans-serif' (zrender DEFAULT_FONT) but draws it in the chart font.

sort 'asc': C, A, B; asc ties lower dataIndex first
sort false: written order, visibleMin off
sort null PRESENT: no sort (absent would be desc)
sort 0 (falsy): no sort; values 1 then 9 stack along y (rfl 500 != 760)
sort 'desc' on (1, 9): b first, 684 x 500 then a 76 x 500
three equal leaves p, q, r: desc ties put the HIGHER dataIndex first (r, q, p)
three equal leaves: asc keeps p, q, r
ties on two levels, plus a tie across a parent and a leaf
levels border / gap [3 4 #333, 2 2, 1 1]: insets, (h - lo) - lou, the root background #333
series itemStyle borderWidth 2 gapWidth 3 borderColor #444 (every depth)
an item borderWidth 6 / gapWidth 5 / borderColor on B, a borderRadius 4 on the series
zero and tiny values with the default sort: removed by visibleMin 10, siblings grow
the same with sort false: slivers stay (0-high z, 0.0253-wide tiny with an empty tspan)
the same with asc: the cut from the front
every value 0: the root has no viewChildren, drawn as a leaf with fill undefined and the series name as label
a parent whose children are all 0: drawn as a leaf in its palette colour
P value 10 with children 1 and 1: the children still fill P (380 x 250 each)
a negative value clamped to 0, an array value [7, 3] (value = 7, {c} would print 7,3), a missing parent value summed
data []: only the virtual root, sum 0: a leaf with no fill
levels[1].color ['#111', '#222']: palette suppressed; depth-1 leaves fill undefined (no fill), depth-2 children mapped by sorted index
levels[0].color ['#123', 'red'] (user list replaces the palette; two entries wrap)
levels [{}, {color: []}]: an EMPTY list still counts as a colour define; nothing maps, nothing is filled
levels[1].itemStyle.color '#aa3344': suppresses the palette and paints every depth-1 node, inherited below
an item colour '#123456' on a parent is inherited; a child's own 'red' wins
series itemStyle.color '#abcdef' loses to the palette-designated colour at depth >= 1
series itemStyle.color '#abcdef' with the palette suppressed by levels[2].color: depth-1 nodes take the series colour
eleven roots: n9 wraps to palette[0], n10 to palette[1]
eleven roots with a zero among them: visibleMin removes it and shifts the later indices
a top-level color ['#f00', '#0f0', '#00f'] is the global palette setDefault copies
border colours per level and per item
nameless nodes under series name 'Ser': labels and crumbs fall back to 'Ser'; {b} stays ''
nameless nodes, unnamed series: no text (a Text with no tspans)
levels[1].name 'LevelOne' names the nameless depth-1 nodes
formatter '{b}': a nameless leaf gets an empty label
formatter '{b}:{c}' (the completed raw value, an array printed 7,3) and an item formatter '{a}!'
label.show false on an item and on levels[2]
label fontSize 14 on the series, 20 on levels[2], label colour #000 on an item
narrow cells: 'Elephantine' cut with and without the ellipsis, down to '' (containerWidth 0)
short cells: line drop (ch < 22 at 12px drops the only line; isTruncated with no tspan)
a CJK name, a 'two\nlines' name (the second line dropped in a short cell, kept in a tall one), a name with an astral character

guards.mutation: no palette on levels[0] (setDefault skipped)
a falsy sort (false / null / 0) sorts desc
`rfl * (rfl * ratio)` instead of `(rfl * rfl) * ratio` in worst()
`rfl === rect.height ? 1 : 0` (a square rect runs vertically)
`x + (w - last)` instead of `(x + w) - last`
the last item of a row takes `step`, not the remainder
desc ties by ascending dataIndex
no visibleMin filter
visibleMin never reduces the running sum (compares, and shares the kept area, against the unreduced sum)
`A * v / sum` instead of `v / sum * A`
`h - (lo + lou)` instead of `(h - lo) - lou`
re-sum `row.area` after the pop (not the running subtraction)
children take the grandparent's visuals
palette by dataIndex instead of the sorted, filtered index
the 5e-5 needLocalTransform rule ignored
`bw + (tx + cw / 2)` label anchor
lines taller than the label box kept
no minChar reserve before the ellipsis check
label z2 = host z2 + 2 (not the running maximum)
breadcrumb findTarget in transformed coordinates
breadcrumb union uses the polygon's maxX instead of bbox.x + bbox.width
M2: the saturation dataExtent taken AFTER the visibleMin cut (upstream: before)
M2: calculateColor applies a colorSaturation of 0 (upstream: truthiness, 0 changes nothing)
M2: a degenerate dataExtent (min == max) maps to range[0] (upstream: linearMap gives 0.5, the middle of the range)
M2: borderColorSaturation applied to the node's raw colour (upstream: to calculateColor, after its own saturation)
M2: no dataStyleTask (the raw item itemStyle color / borderColor / opacity would not override the visual)
M2: the content label ignores the node style's opacity
M2: hsla2rgba takes h = H / 360 without ((H % 360) + 360) % 360
M2: hsla2rgba truncates the channels (upstream: Math.round, then clamp)
M3: a header on every node with an upperLabelHeight, leaves included (upstream: parents only)
M3: the header rect height is upperLabelHeight (upstream: upperHeight = max(borderWidth, upperLabelHeight))
M3: no label.formatter fallback for the header text
M3: a negative header rect width is not flipped by BoundingRect.applyTransform
M3: position 'inside' coloured by the outside rule
M3: the default position [0, '50%'] coloured by the inside (luminance) rule
M3: the inside fill ignores the background's luminance
M3: 'inside' used over a background with no fill (upstream: Path.canBeInsideText is hasFill, so the outside rule applies)
M3: an option colour keeps the auto stroke
M3: dark mode ignored in the outside colour
M3: the outside stroke ignores the background's alpha (no blend over white)
